_note: r.164(3)(d) and (6)(d): "has income to be apportioned in accordance with provisions of section 10". s.10: a husband and wife governed by the community of property system ("COMMUNIAO DOS BENS", Portuguese Civil Code of 1860) in Goa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu; income under each head other than "Salaries" divided equally. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2026-27 only: r.164(1) governs "the tax year commencing on the 1st April, 2026" (D-520 C3a).
question: Is your income divided between you and your spouse under the community-of-property system (section 10)?
